name: cidr-input
title: CIDR Input
description: Reads an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR back as its exact range and address count, catches host bits set (offering both the network and single-host readings), and warns on 0.0.0.0/0, a missing prefix, leading zeros and overlaps with existing ranges.

meta.summary: Reads a CIDR block back as its exact range and size, and warns before a firewall rule opens to the whole internet or overlaps an existing range.
meta.server: Validate rules in your cloud or firewall API and review changes to public ranges there.
catches: Host bits set in the address, with the network or /32 (/128) reading as fixes
Overlap with, or nesting inside, the existing ranges you pass, named
A missing prefix length and ambiguous leading zeros
limits: Only compares against the ranges you pass in `existing`
It doesn't know whether a wide range is intended for a public service
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" hint
Fix buttons have aria-labels ("Use …") and return focus to the input
The bit diagram is aria-hidden; the range is stated in text
